community_list_entries.name: MemoReason: Evaluating the Effect of Parametric Memory on Contextual Reasoning in LLMs

phase1_classification.kind_reason: The paper introduces a human-curated benchmark: 100 documents x 12 QA = 1,200 factual tasks, each with 10 fictitious variants. It is built to measure how parametric memory (facts memorized in weights) affects contextual reasoning. Data is on HF at zineddine/MemoReason.
